notes.title: Halloween Extra! Dai's Trick or Treat!
notes.notes:
Salutation Quantumers and community!

It's that spooky time of year - and what better way to celebrate it than with an extra serving of Quantum Suicide!

A new round of the Deletion Game has been lovingly crafted and is now available in the Extra's menu (on the second page!) If it isn't there, log out of Steam and back in and the update for Quantum Suicide should be available. (I am unsure why it does this T . T)

This round of the Deletion Game is also unlike others - and includes some randomized elements - meaning, you should be able to play the event more than once and have a (somewhat) different experience! :D

The Trick or Treat event also has partial Japanese V.A - if you don't like it, please turn the VA volume down to 0 in the preference menu :) If you do like it - yay! my efforts were worth your happiness! 

Enjoy! 

<3 MoltenCherry

P.S. I am continuing to work on improving Quantum Suicide! Please know that I am still supporting this game (with more updates and patched planned for future), and a big thank you so much for supporting it too! <3

notes.title: Bug fixes and patches on hold until February :)
notes.notes:
Dearest Quantumers and Community!

This is a quick message to let you know that I will be MIA until February due to mandated medical leave! Or, as I like to think of it, a really boring holiday. 

Long story very short - I don’t have coronavirus, nor am I dying (yet, anyway mwahahaha) - but to prevent further complications with my health, I am on bed rest with limited screen time until at least February. This “holiday” is to prevent: medication, surgery, organ failure and woot, in the super rare chance, death. As I said, not serious yet, but let's keep it that way :D

notes.title: Happy New Years~ Update 01.01.211
notes.notes:
Salutation Quantumers and Happy New Year!

A quick thank you for all the Quantumers who have come back to play both the extended endings and the Xmas special - as well as to all our new Quantumers who have joined in the recent Steam Sale - Thank you for playing Quantum Suicide and WELCOME <3 

To start the year off with a bang, I am dropping update/patch 01.01.211 :D

Thank you to everyone who has been reporting bugs and errors! I am working through them all and hope to fix them all ASAP! :D

What to expect in this update:

- Information regarding softlock and unlocks!
A few players were finding the soft locks and unlocks a little confusing, so I have added screens that notify you if you have hit a soft lock (a part in a timeline that you can't progress through) as well as a notification when these soft locks have been opened (including an image of the timeline and which part has opened!)
If you like, or don't like this - I would love some feedback! :D

- 2 New CG's in the CG gallery!
I have added two CG's to the gallery: one [spoiler] when Dai is surrounded by dead bodies - this is seen in chapter 4 girl Nikolas route but didn't have a CG in the gallery - woops [/spoiler] and two [spoiler] The Ai ending of the XMAS special. The Dai image is a modified version of the other CG and so I haven't repeated it! [/spoiler]

- Fixed CG's for unlocking!
Two CG's were not unlocking, but now should be! To unlock these (if they haven't unlocked for you), you will need to replay a scene (Sorry!) - If these still don't open for you, please let me know! 
CG1: [spoiler] Ai's drawing she makes with Melody - Chapter One, spend time with Melody [/spoiler]
CG2: [spoiler] The protagonist's drawing of Kimiko -  Chapter One, spend time with Melody, and then choose to draw Kimiko [/spoiler]

- Achievement repairs!
I have attempted to fix the following achievements that have been not unlocking for some people (both in game and/or Steam). If you could please try these fixes, and if they still don't unlock, please tell me! I have tested on my end, and they work, buuuuuuuttttt we all know that isn't how development works :P

1. [spoiler] Mars is my Home Planet - Please start a new game and select to play as a male then save the game and check your achievements :D [/spoiler]

2. [spoiler] For Better or Worse. - If this has unlocked in Steam, but not in game, please start a new game and it should automatically unlock in the game achievements *fingers crossed*  [/spoiler]

3. [spoiler] One plus Two is Me? - I have made a second possible way for this to unlock! To test this achievement, please replay the Boy Kimiko route Don't Jump (after you have passed the softlocks)  [/spoiler]

4. [spoiler] Liar Liar, pants on fire - This achievement is what haunts my dreams. Please replay the prologue, ensuring to lie to Sora and Vlad and then if you are a girl, partner with Shizuka and Katashi, and if you are a boy, partner with the Vogels. This should now unlock and sync. [/spoiler]

If you are missing any of the above achievements and they still don't unlock (either in Steam or in-game), please let me know so I can attempt to try again and fix for you! :D

- Achievement added!
A new achievement has been added! If you want to know what it is and where to get it, here it is:
[spoiler] Heads I win, Tails you lose - Play scissors paper rock with Shizuka and no matter what happens, she claims she wins (even when she clearly doesn't!) - to unlock this achievement, you will need to speak with Shizuka on day 1 of Chapter 2 (Girl - Shizuka and Yoshiki Route)  [/spoiler]

Further repairs include:

- The multitude of Kimiko's that decided to appear when speaking about the black hole! (There is now only one!)

- About 25 grammatical and spelling errors that have been reported!

What I am working on: (I haven't forgotten these reports, promise!)

- VA repairs (trying to get correct lines together to fix the few mistakes in English that have been reported! 
- A mishap happening when speaking with Nikolas and Beatrix about clues. 
- More transition inclusions
- Fixing the skip button for Deletion Game explanations 

(If I have forgotten something I need to fix, feel free to remind me here! My brain is a bit fried :P)

Okay! Well that is all I have fixed and hope you all enjoy the rest of your NEW YEARS DAY and your holidays :D

<3 MoltenCherry!

P.S. - If you do like Quantum Suicide and haven't left a review, please do! :D I reeeeeaaaallly would like to get to 80% positive on Steam! Then, if I dai any time soon, I can dai happy :P

notes.title: Christmas Everett Event!
notes.notes:
Salutation Quantumers and Merrrrrry Xmas!

To celebrate the festive period (and the current Steam Winter Sale), I have added an additional chapter to the game via the EXTRAS menu. I am proud to present Christmas Everett! A small playable chapter in which you play as Ai preparing for the Everett's Christmas party! 

To access this additional content, please go to the EXTRAS menu, then press the right button to access page 2! Here you will find the Christmas Everett, as well as Dai's Xmas Song beneath it. This is a credit video for the Christmas Everett that really serves as a Dai Xmas Carol Sing along~ You can save your game as per usual, however, this section is not available on the timeline as it is an "extra".

Christmas Everett isn't voiced, but I hope you can still enjoy it anyway!

If you go to page 2 and nothing is there - you need to update your game :) In the credits page, the current version should read: 25.12.001

I hope you all have a wonderful Holiday period and enjoy the new year festivities the best you can! 

<3 MoltenCherry

P.S. - I have another patch coming shortly attempting to fix some ongoing achievement issues and small fixes in the girl route :D

notes.title: QUANTUM SUICIDE WILL BE RELEASED ON SEPTEMBER 10!
notes.notes:
Dearest Quantumers!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35746704/87e80b72b9ff284e982e109bb8c5e07a9224fede.jpg[/img]

We are so very pleased to finally announce a hard release date for Quantum Suicide - SEPTEMBER 10!

Although the game is not out yet (but will be shortly), We want to take this opportunity to thank every single one of you for sticking by us, and continuing to support us - especially when development seemed to be never ending. 

Thank you! We couldn't have gotten this far without you!
(Think of your support as the energy used in a DBZ spirit bomb - you made this possible!)

Well - We best get back to working on Quantum Suicide :)
See you in 4 days Quantumers! 

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: Quantum Suicide Update!
notes.notes:
Good Afternoon Quantumers!

Thank you all so much for taking the time to read this update and I hope you are all taking care of each other <3

After being sick for almost 4 months, production is back on and we are progressing well!

A final beta build should be out within a week for the English testing and the Japanese LQA is already underway! 

Release ETA is late August! But once it is confirmed, a countdown will begin!

Again, I wish that Quantum Suicide wasn't delayed again, but I really want to thank you all for your ongoing patience and excitement!! :D

I hope to update you soon with further good news!

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: The Imminent release of Quantum Suicide!
notes.notes:
[b]Salutations Quantumers and Community!~[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35746704/8f85d742116ac31b16c198b46cf6009d94c375da.png[/img]
We are pushing hard to complete the game and have it released by the end of February, however, if we don't get it up to standard (because you all deserve the best!), we can assure everyone that it WILL BE released before the end of March! 

We know this for sure, as we have all the VA ready and it's just a matter of getting it all in as well as final bug checks and changes :)

Myself, and the team of 50 Quantum Suicide Beta Testing Officers are working hard and endlessly to get Quantum Suicide in to tip top shape for release!

Thank you for sticking around and supporting us through all our delays and challenges! I can see the light at the end of the tunnel~ We are so close

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: New ETA Release Date for Quantum Suicide!
notes.notes:
A quick thank you to everyone who has wish listed us this far!

The game is now in Beta Testing, however, is still missing some of the voice acting. 

After a democratic process, the Quantumer community has decided to hold off on the official release until all voice acting is in and final :)

The new ETA release for Quantum Suicide is February. We are doing everything we humanly can to recast missing actors and get Quantum Suicide to you as soon as possible!! Updates will be posted to ensure transparency with everyone in our wonderful community! 

Thank you for standing by us, even in turbulent times! We truly do appreciate it <3 
It almost makes me sad that Dai is going to eventually kill all of you :D

<3 MoltenCherry

notes.title: Let the wish listing Begin!
notes.notes:
Dearest Quantumers and Future Quantumers :D


Sorry that we haven't updated in a while, but, this is a good update! (I hope you think it is good too~)

Quantum Suicide is officially up on Steam as coming soon and available to wish list!

Legend has it,  every time someone adds Quantum Suicide to their Steam Wish List, a Kappa - A Japanese mythical creature - is born and wreak mischief upon the world. Be part of that.

We are currently in Alpha, soon to hit Beta, and shortly after, release!!

Who's excited to Dai!? :P

<3 MoltenCherry
